decisions.decision: Loaded Vibes is optimized for generator UX, user time saved, and product-fit rather than governance or validation breadth.
CLI, web configurator, and loadedvibes.json share one recipe core.
Vibes remains the upstream SaaS template/reference; Loaded Vibes packages a self-contained derivative for generation.
Initial web configurator is stateless and requires no Loaded Vibes user account or database.
